notes.title: Thank you for waiting for Sex Wishes! 🔮
notes.content:
We’ve made a lot of changes and improvements, and we’re excited to share them with you! 

Can’t wait to dive in?

🎯 Here’s what’s new:✅ Improved Magic System:We’ve made magic more physical and fun! Now, in addition to lighting poles, you can attract, push, and throw objects to make your magic more interactive. The magic feels more alive than ever! 💫✅ Updated Stamina & Health System:We’ve fixed the stamina and health system, making the gameplay smoother and more balanced.✅ New Quests:Several new quests have been added, unlocking exciting new storylines and character interactions for you to explore.✅ Erotic Puzzle Rewards:We’ve enhanced the puzzle mechanics, and now completing them rewards you with erotic cards to add some extra spice to your journey.✅ Narrative & Character Updates:We’ve improved the storyline and character development, making the narrative more engaging and dynamic.✅ New Characters:Meet Illyria, a studious elf, and Guinevere, a playful witch — two exciting new characters to add even more flavor to the game.✅ Character Visual Upgrades:We’ve given all characters a visual upgrade and are working on refining their textures to make them more detailed and lifelike.✅ Lighting Improvements:We’re improving the lighting for a more immersive experience and to set the right mood for your magical adventures.✅ Real-Time Adult Scenes & Enhanced Breast Physics:We’ve added real-time adult scenes and improved breast physics for a more realistic and satisfying experience during the intimate moments. 😉✅ Voice Acting & UI Enhancements:We’re working on upgrading the AI voice acting and refining the UI for a smoother, more polished gameplay experience.✅ Romance & Relationship System:You can now build relationships with your love interests, find them gifts, and unlock unique dialogues and adult content based on your interactions. The more you care, the more you’ll unlock! 💕✨ Don’t forget to add Sex Wishes to your wishlist!The magic, the passion, and the adventure are just getting started. Be the first to experience the new features!
